author: Akien
prose:
IDEA INTENTION TICKET and CHART --- ARE PLANNING. we need to stop looking at tickets like most of software does. and start looking at them as the plan for that idea. we don't need to be pushing questions in as much as the end decisions and how they line up.

the ticket becomes the history, and at the same time, the plan is spawned. from here, when we say ticket we mean the plan artifact and the history artifact, two related files. to build something, you only need the plan. if something is unclear, then you need the history.

the plan is always the 'current what to do' all questions answered, all intentions clear. the questions and the answering of them is in the ticket log. maybe it's ticket log and ticket plan?
